_meta.what: Variables in quantified relation for the tissue twin, with edge status and an evidence pointer per edge.
_meta.why: GRAPH_MAP lists constraint nets for vehicle, projector and fleet_factory plus a stress map. No net exists for tissue, and dental confirmed on 2026-10-03 that they have none either. This is the layer the operator means by the graph: quantities coupled by relations whose status is TIGHT, OPEN or UNKNOWN, with each edge tightened by a measurement rather than asserted. Every edge below carries a number this session verified in the producing run's own artefact files.
_meta.schema: Same shape as CONSTRAINT_NET_PROJECTOR.json: variables with unit, edges with status and evidence as {file, key, value}.

status_meaning.TIGHT: the relation is quantified and a measurement constrains it
status_meaning.OPEN: the relation exists and is measured to be insufficient or undetermined; the gap is the number
status_meaning.UNKNOWN: the relation is asserted in a model but no measurement bears on it

_meta.rule: An edge may be added only with a verified number and a file pointer. No edge from a model assumption alone; such a relation is UNKNOWN and says so.
